# XIIV — reference for AI coding assistants

XIIV is a tiny masked-diffusion language model (10,059,840 params), trained
from scratch on CPU. It does NOT predict left-to-right: every generation
starts as a blank field of [MASK] tokens and resolves the most confident
positions in parallel over N denoising steps. Brand is always "XIIV"
(uppercase); the Python package directory is lowercase `xiiv/` (required).

## Install

    git clone https://github.com/CYPHERLYNX/XIIV.git && cd XIIV
    python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
    # Windows: setup.bat  (or train_xiiv_gpu.ps1 for RTX GPU training)

No PyPI package. Inference makes zero network calls; weights, tokenizer and
config ship in `weights/`.

## Python API (`xiiv/api.py`)

    from xiiv import XIIV
    m = XIIV("weights/xiiv.safetensors")          # also loads config.json + tokenizer.json
    m.infill("The <mask> sat on the <mask>.", seed=3)   # masked-span infilling
    m.generate(length=128, steps=16, seed=7)            # generate from noise
    m.generate(length=160, prompt="Once upon a time")   # prompt-conditioned

`infill` preserves locked (unmasked) context exactly. Both are deterministic
given `seed`. `m.n_params` == 10_059_840.

## CLI

    .venv/bin/python -m xiiv.sample generate --length 128 --steps 16 --seed 7
    .venv/bin/python -m xiiv.sample infill --text "The <mask> sat on the <mask>."
    .venv/bin/python -m xiiv.sample generate --scratchpad 32 --length 128   # reasoning-first
    .venv/bin/python -m xiiv.sample generate --refine-rounds 2              # self-correction
    .venv/bin/python -m xiiv.serve   # local demo at http://localhost:8765/ (127.0.0.1 only)

## Constraints (enforced DURING denoising, measured 1.000 on all four)

- required tokens force-placed; forbidden tokens masked to -inf in logits
- locked spans (infill context) never written; output always exactly the
  requested length
- see `xiiv/diffusion.py`: `check_constraints`, `sample_trajectory`

## Training (reproduce)

    .venv/bin/python scripts/prepare_data.py --out-dir data \
        --train-chars 150000000 --valid-chars 5000000   # TinyStories, CC-BY
    .venv/bin/python -m xiiv.train --data data --ckpt-dir checkpoints \
        --total-steps 5000 --batch-size 48 --bf16       # resumable, Ctrl-C safe
    .venv/bin/python -m xiiv.evaluate --weights weights/xiiv.safetensors
    .venv/bin/python scripts/export_weights.py --ckpt checkpoints/best.pt

Frozen configs with hashes: `checkpoints_*/run_config.json`. Full recipe in
TRAINING.md. GPU (RTX 4050): `.\train_xiiv_gpu.ps1`.

## Key files

- `xiiv/model.py` — 6L bidirectional transformer, d=320, 5 heads, SwiGLU-864,
  RoPE, RMSNorm, tied embeddings, no causal mask
- `xiiv/diffusion.py` — forward mask process, `sample_trajectory`,
  `generate_with_scratchpad`, `self_refine`, `generate_long`
- `xiiv/vision.py` — UNtrained multimodal architecture scaffold (do not
  present as a capability)
- `weights/` — shipped fp32 safetensors (38.4 MiB) + tokenizer.json + config.json
- `benchmarks/` — constraint + throughput benchmarks; `scripts/check_gates.py`

## Honest numbers (do not inflate)

- best val masked-NLL 3.4021 nats/token = an UPPER BOUND, not comparable to
  autoregressive perplexity; never compare numerically
- promotion gates 8/9 — G7 (throughput) FAILED at 19.4 tok/s vs 25 required;
  recorded as failed, not waived
- 31/31 test suites; outputs are rough (TinyStories
  English); the 52.5M-param XIIV (52,508,736 params, best val 3.3414) completed
  2026-10-02 — weights ship as the xiiv-52m-v0.1 release asset
  (`weights_52m/xiiv-52m-fp16.safetensors`, fp16, 105 MB)
- no emojis anywhere in the repo (project rule)
